# Two Case Studies and a Capstone, First

This part is out of order on purpose. In the single book these
three chapters come last, because they apply every earlier part.
Here, at the front of Volume 1, they are a preview: read them as a
look at where the book is going, not as an exercise to complete
now. Nothing here assumes you have read the chapters that follow;
every tool they use is named as it appears, with a pointer to the
chapter that actually teaches it, in this volume or in Volume 2 or
3. Skip this part entirely and come back to it once you have
finished the rest of the book, or read it now for the motivation
and skim past what does not yet make sense.

- @sec-penguins works a complete analysis on the Palmer penguins
  data and maps each step to the chapter that taught it.
- @sec-adni works a harder case, prediction of conversion from mild
  cognitive impairment, with data held under a data-use agreement.
- @sec-synthesis takes the HF-HOME study from a multi-site
  case-report-form export to a deposited compendium with a tagged
  analysis plan, executed tests, continuous integration, a one-page
  memo, and a response to a reviewer.

There is no quiz for this part. Read as much or as little as helps.
